responsibility: Contains Darwin/Mach-O-specific machine-description patterns for the rs6000 backend. It supplies RTL expands and insns for Mach-O high/lo relocations, low-part symbol loads and stores, PIC base setup and correction, Darwin call sequences, and nonlocal-goto PIC register restoration, covering target-specific lowering that cannot be expressed through the generic PowerPC instruction patterns alone.
same_name_distinction: This is the Darwin machine-description file: it provides Mach-O-specific RTL expands and insns such as lo_sum accesses, PIC base setup, and Darwin call sequences. Unlike darwin.h, it is not the macro/spec configuration layer, and unlike darwin.opt, it does not define options.
